title: City Council District 1
statement: Brooklyn needs us to act now, not later. The Tenant Defense Fund is moving—I'm filing the ordinance today because displacement doesn't pause for process. And to Brooklyn's storefronts: submit your municipal service plans by week's end so we can direct stabilization dollars where they'll matter most.

payload.text: Co-sponsoring INIT-010 West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund ordinance and requiring Brooklyn commercial corridor service plans.
